description: Sentry CLI (`sentry-cli`): release deletion, release bookkeeping, and read commands.

rules.note: `releases delete` removes a release with its files and deploy data.

safe.note: The configuration check (it does not print the token), listings of releases, projects, organizations, repositories, deploys, and files, release details, and a proposed version name.

Release bookkeeping for the error reports of the project: a new or finalized release, its commits, a deploy record, and source map or debug file uploads. It adds data to Sentry only. It does not change the app or its data, and a release can be deleted. `gh pr create` is known safe for the same reason.
